parsed.reason: Real, age-grounded coaching for 5-year-old Milo. It normalises the behaviour, then gives a concrete thing to do tonight: state the plan, walk him back every time, stay quiet, use a morning sticker. No diagnosis, no medicine, no handback, and the appended plan offer is correct. The small blemish is length: the advice alone runs well past the roughly 300-character budget, so the tail risks being cut.
